summary_md: **Aadit Singal ([@adidevv0](https://x.com/adidevv0/status/2115787187333829103))** built **Mantis**, a lean browser interface for AI agents; on the same tasks, models and real sites it matched Playwright MCP accuracy with up to 47% fewer tokens, about a third faster and about 30% fewer tool calls ([perzianhq/mantis](https://github.com/perzianhq/mantis)).
